text:
Lucy P.: Heads-up — Partner ACME reported a reproducible crash on their marketplace image when running long quantized inference jobs (seen on our perf tests and a customer CI). Stack: NVIDIA driver 535.xx + CUDA 12.2, model quantized to 4-bit. Crash signature looks like a KV cache corruption. Ravi S.: Sorry — we're seeing the same on their SI integration tests, can reproduce with the provided Docker image. Full stacktrace sent to the partner. Devon W.: Can you paste the minimal repro command? Harper K.: Repro (from ACME): ```python
# run short loop to repro
for i in range(200):
  out = client.generate(prompt, max_tokens=1024)
```
Crash occurs ~iteration 90-120. Devon W.: Minimal smoke test I used: `python -m examples.client --model=redwood/llm-quant --tokens=1024 --loops=200` — consistent. Marta L.: On our infra, toggling KV cache off avoids the crash, which matches a KV corruption theory. Dev-team hypothesis: a driver/kernel-path in CUDA 12.2 + certain microcode causes an OOB write under heavy KV reuse. Lucy P.: Important: ACME plans a marketplace announcement next week. We need a coordinated mitigation + comms plan — either pin image to a safe driver/CUDA or push a hotfix image. Ravi S.: Partner preference is to pin their marketplace image to NVIDIA 530.x (they have a working baseline) rather than block the announcement. They can cut a new image if we give exact gating matrix. Devon W.: Proposed short-term plan: 1) Create a pinned marketplace image using NVIDIA 530.x + CUDA 12.1, label `acme-gpu-pinned-530` 2) Run partner SI regression suite + our perf smoke (200-loop) 3) If green, let partner announce but include nod that we recommend pinned image for heavy-quant workloads 4) Parallel: eng-runtime to backport a KV-cache guard (low-risk) for next patch. Harper K.: I'll run the ML test matrix against pinned image across our dataset (eval prompt set) — ETA 6hrs. Marta L.: I'll schedule a Saturday hotfix window if we need to push image replacements in partner marketplace. deploy-bot: new-release created: `acme-gpu-pinned-530` -> build 20260321. Ravi S.: ACME will hold the announcement until we validate the pinned image; they asked for an ETA by EOD PT. Devon W.: Can eng-runtime prioritize a KV-cache safe-guard PR? If we get that in a couple of days, we can unpin in next release. Devon W.: I'll open PR and mark it high-priority, but it's a risk-sensitive change — will need CI + a small canary rollout. Lucy P.: Action items summary: - Ravi: coordinate partner image cut and confirm they can roll back announcement - Marta: book the hotfix slot and run infra smoke - Harper: run eval matrix against pinned image - Devon: PR for KV-cache guard, open canary plan - All: post final go/no-go in this thread by 18:00 PT. Please @mention if blocked. :eyes: Ravi S.: Partner confirms they can cut pinned image by 14:00 PT and will hold announcement. I'll post the partner CI logs here when ready. Harper K.: Starting evals now. Devon W.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/877 — will attach test logs. Lucy P.: Thanks team — keep updates short in-thread so partner execs can follow. :thumbsup:
